skill.summary: Error monitoring and alerting for AI agents. Detect, track, and resolve errors in real-time. Triggers: error monitoring, error tracking, alerting, exception...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of error-monitoring-agent.

- Real-time error detection and tracking across logs, APIs, and worker processes.
- Aggregates and groups similar errors to simplify analysis and pattern recognition.
- Customizable alerting on error rates, new error types, and spikes with multiple notification channels.
- Root cause analysis tools correlate errors with deployments and configuration changes.
- Supports automatic resolution using approved remediation strategies.
- Flexible configuration for sources, retention, alert rules, and auto-resolve policies.
